Package eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.publication.xmldefs

Record Class AIcgdGlobalPublicationDeployMetadata_1

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
eu.algites.pltf.modustro.builder.publication.xmldefs.AIcgdGlobalPublicationDeployMetadata_1
Record Components:
globalPublicationPathId - Stable logical publication path copied from validated user metadata.
publicationState - Server-controlled publication lifecycle state. Released definitions are immutable and cannot transition back to draft.
publicationRevision - Server-controlled monotonically increasing revision of successfully deployed draft content. Release freezes the current content revision.
firstPublishedAt - Server-generated timestamp of the first successful deployment for this GlobalPublicationPathId.
publishedAt - Server-generated timestamp of the most recent successful deployment or release transition represented by this metadata.
releasedAt - Server-generated timestamp at which this publication became an immutable release; absent while the publication is a draft.
publishedBy - Optional trusted publisher identity derived by the deployment adapter from authenticated execution context; never copied from user metadata.
public record AIcgdGlobalPublicationDeployMetadata_1(String globalPublicationPathId, String publicationState, BigInteger publicationRevision, XMLGregorianCalendar firstPublishedAt, XMLGregorianCalendar publishedAt, XMLGregorianCalendar releasedAt, String publishedBy) extends Record
Deployment-controlled publication metadata generated from validated user metadata and trusted publisher state.
